title: Backport of upstream QEMU commit 4af976ef398e ("rbd: Fix .bdrv_get_specific_info
description:
Backport of upstream QEMU commit 4af976ef398e ("rbd: Fix .bdrv_get_specific_info
implementation", Kevin Wolf, QEMU 10.1.0) for LP: #2166503.

qemu_rbd_get_specific_info() performs a blocking rbd_read() on the main thread
with the BQL held every time query-named-block-nodes runs. libvirt sends that
command during ordinary block-stats collection (virsh domstats --block,
OpenStack, monitoring exporters), so a slow or QoS-throttled Ceph image freezes
the whole guest. The fix probes once at image open and answers queries from the
stored value.

- Applies to 8.2.2 with line offsets only: 10 hunks, 9 in block/rbd.c and one
  doc-comment-only hunk in qapi/block-core.json. No schema or ABI change. No
  existing noble patch touches either file.
- Test-built on noble amd64 (dpkg-buildpackage, all 22 binaries). The built
  block-rbd.so no longer contains the removed "cannot read image start for
  probe" path; the stock 1.18 module does.
- Earlier measurement on real Ceph hardware with the same patch hand-built into
  8.2.2 under an 8 MiB/s rbd_qos_bps_limit: virsh domstats --block went from
  60.39 s with the guest fully frozen to 0.14-0.15 s. I will repeat it with
  this exact build and report on the bug.
- Already fixed in resolute (10.2.1) and stonking (11.0.3) via the upstream
  version. Upstream stable-8.2 is closed (QEMU GitLab #4451), so a distro patch
  is the only route. Red Hat requested the same fix for RHEL 10 (RHEL-105440,
  the Buglink in the upstream commit).
- Version set to 1:8.2.2+ds-0ubuntu1.20 on top of the 1.19 currently in
  noble-proposed; please adjust if another upload lands first.
